changes.t: AAG is now Astro-Core under NSF 26-522 (posted Aug 17, 2026). Proposals are accepted anytime, and the solicitation sets no target date; FY2027 is flagged as especially competitive.

NASA says it will release ROSES-27 no later than January 2027 and has not issued a ROSES-26; ATP, ADAP, FINESST and most guest-investigator calls are waiting on it. Under ROSES-25, NuSTAR Cycle 13 and new second opportunities for Swift, Fermi and TESS take Phase-1 proposals by Jan 28, 2027. LISA Preparatory Science was last solicited in ROSES-2024 and is not in ROSES-2025.
WoU-MMA, MPS-Ascend and Mid-scale RI-2 are archived. MRI is waiting for a new solicitation.
Calls for observing time are listed under Telescope Time, and only calls Yale astronomers can apply to are included. Yale's own Keck and Palomar time goes through the Yale Time Allocation Committee.

The President's FY2027 request would cut NSF by 55% and NASA Astrophysics research and analysis to $46.6M, from $116.7M in FY2024. Congress has not passed full-year FY2027 funding; a continuing resolution (P.L. 119-103) funds agencies at rates based on FY2026 levels through Dec 11, 2026.
